# Capitalist Charts

Capitalist Charts is an Apache-2.0 open-source pnpm monorepo of embeddable live market widgets. Widgets are Lit custom elements named `<cap-*>`, beginning with PSX coverage.

## Embed

Load `https://capitalist.pk/widgets/v1/loader.js` as an async module with the jsDelivr fallback shown
in the repository README, then place a catalog tag such as `<cap-quote symbol="PSX:OGDC">`. Keep a
normal link inside the tag for crawlable fallback content.

## Common attributes

Every widget accepts `theme="auto|light|dark|transparent"`, `palette="pk|cvd"`, `density="comfortable|compact"`, and `locale="en|ur"`.

## Events

Widgets emit `cap:ready`, `cap:update`, `cap:error`, cancellable `cap:link`, and `cap:select`. Events bubble and are composed.

## Packages

- `@capitalist-charts/elements`: Lit web components and loader.
- `@capitalist-charts/react`: catalog-generated React wrappers; client-only element registration and provider configuration.
- `@capitalist-charts/ssr`: escaped `embedSnippet`, `fallbackHtml`, and non-throwing `fetchFallbackData`.
- `@capitalist-charts/schema`: QuoteSnapshot, L0/L1 view types, validators, symbol parsing, and paths.
- `@capitalist-charts/core`: DataAdapter, poller, formatters, and resource loading.

The public package release is 1.0.0. Starting with 1.0.1, package releases are published from
GitHub with npm provenance.

## Data

The default static data root is `https://capitalist.pk/w/`. L0 files contain quote snapshots and market status; L1 files contain bounded series and view models. Publishers can configure a compatible `dataBase`, implement `DataAdapter`, or self-host the static tree.

## Trust and scope

The project is focused on simple live embeds and PSX coverage. It does not claim TradingView's global coverage or overall charting power. The hosted service uses public market data and does not require cookies, sign-in, or an API key to copy the embed.
